audit_items.proof_trace: The token endpoint enforces exact-string equality between the request redirect_uri and the DB-stored value (authCode.redirect_uri !== redirectUri at L90, returning 400 on mismatch). redirect_uri is also a required parameter (L36), preventing null bypasses. The stored value originates from the consent action (consent/actions.ts:86, p_redirect_uri) which always receives the redirect_uri validated by the authorize endpoint against the application's allowed list.
